# VibeBuild

> VibeBuild (https://vibebuild.cc) is an AI app builder. You describe an app in plain language and it generates a working web app, shows a live preview, lets you iterate with follow-up requests, and publishes it to a vibebuild.cc subdomain or your own domain.

## What it does

- Describe: write what you want in any language.
- Generate: the app is built as a self-contained web app (HTML, CSS, JavaScript).
- Preview: every build gets a live preview link.
- Iterate: ask for changes and review earlier versions.
- Publish: deploy to a vibebuild.cc subdomain, attach a custom domain, or export to GitHub or an Android APK.

## Where to use it

- Web app: https://vibebuild.cc
- Android app: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.kreativekoala.vibecoder
